name: Import from OpenClaw and Hermes
title: Import from OpenClaw and Hermes: an existing assistant's persona, memory and skills brought into Rouh in one command, previewed first, merged without overwriting, and undone in one more

permissions: reads an OpenClaw or Hermes Agent setup where it is installed (~/.openclaw, ~/.hermes) or at a path given, a folder or a .zip or .tar.gz of one, and nothing else on the machine
adds rules and notes to the person's Synapse Master and skill folders to the workspace's .claude/skills, never changing what is there
opens no .env, credential or auth file unless asked to include secrets, and then keeps only Google's and xAI's keys, sealed, where the organisation has none
answers import_agent in a chat, and python manage.py import_agent on the server
tables: synapse.item (rules and notes it adds, marked imported)
app_state (agent_import:<org>:<user>:<id>, what each import added, for its undo)
touches.remove: Delete rouh/agent_import.py, rouh/management/commands/import_agent.py and this manifest, the import_agent tool in rouh/tools.py and its names in toolsearch.py, toolsides.py, job_policy.py and worklabel.py, the agent-import entry in rouh/genes/owners.json, its row in CONTAINERS.md and its check in tests/stack/checks_genes.py. What was imported stays as ordinary rules, notes and skills.
